description: Climb detection v2 validation dataset. Ground-truth climbs annotated from local knowledge + GPS review. Rows marked annotation_status=pending_review are retained as review hints, not scorecard truth.

files.description: 76min NJ coast ride. Truly flat: 5-15m elevation range. Power meter, no HR. Control file — no real climbs.
files.notes: GPS: 39.91N, -74.93W. Perfect negative-control for false positive testing. All terrain modes correctly find 0 climbs.

files.notes: GPS has some sentinel values (-214.748) but elevation data is clean (-8 to 31m range). terrain=auto classifies as rolling and finds 5 climbs. Good rolling terrain validation.

files.description: 528min (8.8hr) Tucson, AZ ride. 1967m gain, 705-1638m elevation. Mt. Lemmon area. Power meter, no HR.
files.notes: GPS: 31.71-32.32N, 111.10-110.84W. REAL mountainous terrain. terrain=auto correctly classifies as mountainous. Annotations revised 2026-03-20: foothills updated to full detected extent (was 119m/5657s, now 275m/4840s), mid-mountain removed (no detector finds it as discrete segment), return climb added (190m visible in elevation data).

expected_climbs.name: Tucson foothills approach
expected_climbs.notes: Continuous 14.6km approach from 774m to 1085m. Detectors find the full extent starting at ~4839. Original annotation (119m at 5657) described a narrower segment mid-climb.

expected_climbs.name: Mt. Lemmon main ascent
expected_climbs.notes: The big one. 8.2km at 6.3%. 31 minutes. auto mode finds this. Should be HC or Cat 1.

expected_climbs.name: Return foothills climb
expected_climbs.notes: Return through foothills. 200m gain from 876m to 1077m visible in elevation profile. Not in original annotations.

The old unanchored 'Major climb' annotation was stale; only two short steep efforts are clearly corroborated by both canonical_v2 and persistence.

files.description: 36-min ride focused on Manayunk Wall (Lyceum Ave). No power, no HR. 213m naive gain. GPS: 39.96-40.03N, 75.18-75.22W.
files.notes: The Wall is the canonical Philly wall climb. terrain=auto classifies as rolling, finds 2 (correct!). v1 hilly mode MISSES the Wall (below 120s time_min). Critical v2 validation case.

expected_climbs.name: Manayunk approach
expected_climbs.notes: Longer gradual climb up to the ridge. All presets find this.

expected_climbs.name: Manayunk Wall (Lyceum Ave)
expected_climbs.notes: THE Wall. ~525m, 11.2% avg. v1 hilly mode MISSES this (below 120s time_min). v2 MUST detect this.
